# Docs

- Architecture Decisions
  - [Architecture Decisions](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr): The significant, hard-to-reverse choices behind shalgalt-omr — what we picked, the alternatives, and the consequences accepted.
  - [ADR 0001 — Windows OpenCV strategy](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0001-windows-opencv-strategy): Provision OpenCV at Windows build time via the prebuilt upstream self-extractor rather than vcpkg, Chocolatey, or LFS-vendored binaries.
  - [ADR 0002 — PDF generator: printpdf](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0002-pdf-generator-printpdf): Adopt the pure-Rust printpdf engine with embedded Noto fonts and lock the OMR bubble geometry the CV pipeline depends on.
  - [ADR 0003 — Cargo workspace & crate boundaries](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0003-cargo-workspace-and-crate-boundaries): Split the single P0 crate into a Cargo workspace of app hosts and pure library crates so the grading core is reusable without Tauri.
  - [ADR 0004 — TypeScript bindings via ts-rs](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0004-ts-rs-type-codegen): Generate the frontend's domain types from Rust with ts-rs and gate them in CI so the Rust/TS wire format never silently drifts.
  - [ADR 0005 — PDF generation IPC contract](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0005-pdf-ipc-contract): Path-string commands and on-disk results for the PDF render/preview IPC — never PDF bytes or data URLs across the Tauri bridge.
  - [ADR 0006 — Light theme & comfort typography](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0006-light-theme-and-comfort-typography): Make light the default theme via mode-watcher with dark opt-in, and add a one-toggle comfortable type scale driven by CSS variables.
  - [ADR 0007 — Canvas wrapper & layout modules](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0007-canvas-wrapper-and-layout-modules): A Canvas drawing-surface wrapper plus a module-per-visual-element layout split for shalgalt-pdf.
  - [ADR 0008 — Bubble label position](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0008-bubble-label-position): Option labels are printed inside the bubble circle, matching the Mongolian-school OMR idiom and AMC prior art.
  - [ADR 0009 — ArUco corner markers](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0009-aruco-markers): DICT_6X6_50 markers with IDs 0–3 in TL/TR/BR/BL order replace anonymous corner squares.
  - [ADR 0010 — Fill measurement & confidence](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0010-confidence-band): Per-bubble fill scoring on the warped canvas, the confidence formula, and the locked [0.35, 0.65] needs-review bands.
  - [ADR 0011 — `.shalgalt` project file](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0011-shalgalt-file-format): A zip container with an always-plaintext manifest, streaming read/write, and a fixed internal layout for exam projects.
  - [ADR 0012 — Optional age encryption](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0012-age-encryption): Passphrase-based, ASCII-armored age encryption applied per-entry to .shalgalt payloads, leaving the manifest readable.
  - [ADR 0013 — REST `/v1` & DataStore seam](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0013-rest-api-v1-datastore): Versioned /v1 routes, a database-free DataStore trait in core, and OpenAPI generated from utoipa annotations.
  - [ADR 0014 — Standalone server & rusqlite store](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0014-server-binary-and-rusqlite-store): A shared rusqlite DataStore implementation, with the desktop's read path split from plugin-sql writes.
  - [ADR 0015 — API port & fallback](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0015-api-port-default-and-fallback): An uncommon default port (22345), desktop auto-fallback, and a developer environment override.
  - [ADR 0016 — Partial-marker homography](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0016-partial-marker-homography): Recover perspective from 3 of 4 ArUco markers using per-corner correspondences and RANSAC.
  - [ADR 0017 — GitHub Releases distribution](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0017-github-releases-distribution): Ship desktop bundles and the standalone server through GitHub Releases via tauri-action on v* tags.
  - [ADR 0018 — Opt-in updater](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0018-optin-updater): tauri-plugin-updater with a static gh-pages manifest, default OFF so offline schools never see a prompt.
  - [ADR 0019 — Documentation site](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/adr/0019-docs-fumadocs-and-gh-pages): Adopt Fumadocs as the single docs framework for dev docs, the Mongolian user manual, and the API reference, deployed to GitHub Pages.
- Developer
  - [Overview](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev): Developer documentation for shalgalt-omr — a local-first OMR grading IDE.
  - [Architecture](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev/architecture): Layers, data flow, and the four hard rules that every PR must respect.
  - [Workspace map](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev/workspace): The Cargo workspace — what each app and crate owns.
  - [Build & run](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev/build): System prerequisites and build/run commands for each OS.
  - [Contributing](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev/contributing): Branching model, commit conventions, language rules, and the PR checklist.
  - [Testing](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev/testing): How the Rust and frontend test suites are organized and run.
  - [Architecture decisions](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/dev/adr): How shalgalt-omr records architectural decisions — what an ADR is, when to write one, and the template to follow.

- User Manual
  - [Introduction](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user): shalgalt-omr — grade OMR answer sheets fully offline.
  - [Quick start](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/quick-start): From installing the app to grading your first exam.

  - **Features**
  - [Загвар засварлагч](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/editor): Хариултын хуудасны загварыг визуал засварлагчид зохиох.
  - [Шалгалт удирдах](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/exams): Шалгалт үүсгэх, хариултын түлхүүр (хувилбар) оруулах.
  - [Дүгнэх](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/grading): Сканнердсан хуудаснуудыг багцаар автоматаар дүгнэх.
  - [Гараар шалгах](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/review): Эргэлзээтэй хуудсуудыг бөмбөлөг бүрчлэн нягтлан засах.
  - [Excel рүү гаргах](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/export): Шалгалтын дүнг Excel хүснэгт болгон гаргах, дүнгийн жагсаалт үзэх.
  - [Төслийн файл (.shalgalt)](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/project-files): Бүх шалгалтын төслийг нэг файлд хадгалах, хуваалцах, нээх.

  - **Tips**
  - [Хэвлэх зөвлөмж](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/printing): Хариултын хуудсыг зөв хэвлэх — цаас, бэх, масштаб.
  - [Сканнердах зөвлөмж](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/scanning): Гар утас болон сканнераар хуудас авах — гэрэл, өнцөг, тохиргоо.
  - [Алдаа засах ба түгээмэл асуулт](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/troubleshooting): Түгээмэл тулгардаг асуудлууд ба шийдэл.
  - [Нууцлалын мэдэгдэл](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/privacy): Ямар ч мэдээлэл гадагш илгээдэггүй — бүрэн офлайн.

  - **Examples**
  - Жишээ файлууд
    - [Жишээ файлууд](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/samples): Бэлэн .shalgalt жишээ төслүүд — нээлттэй, шифрлэсэн, PDF-тэй.
    - _payload
  - Видео заавар
    - [Видео зааврын төлөвлөгөө](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/walkthroughs): Танин мэдэх видеонуудын дүр зураг (storyboard).
    - [Storyboard: Эхний шалгалтыг дүгнэх](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/walkthroughs/first-grade): 5 минутын танилцуулга видеоны дүр зураг.
    - [Storyboard: Шифрлэсэн төсөл хуваалцах](https://filename24.github.io/shalgalt-omr/en/docs/user/walkthroughs/encrypted-project): 3 минутын танилцуулга видеоны дүр зураг.
